competitors.name: Costco Wholesale
competitors.action: Supermarket News reported Costco's adjusted comparable-store sales rose 6.7% in fiscal Q4, including 7.2% growth in the U.S. Food and sundries comparable sales increased in the low- to mid-single digits, led by packaged foods, sundries and frozen foods, while Costco said it continued to win with both value-focused and indulgence-oriented members.

competitors.name: Fontanini Foods
competitors.action: USDA FSIS announced that Fontanini Foods is recalling approximately 2,320 pounds of raw, frozen pork sausage links after two customer complaints involving clear, hard plastic. The 10-pound foodservice cases were shipped to distributors in California, Florida, Michigan and Nevada; no injuries were confirmed as of the Sept. 25 notice.

trends.topic: Club-channel grocery growth is extending into frozen foods
trends.magnitude: Costco's adjusted Q4 comparable sales rose 6.7% overall and 7.2% in the U.S.; frozen foods were among the categories leading low- to mid-single-digit food-and-sundries comparable growth.
trends.context: This is Costco-wide performance rather than frozen-pizza-specific velocity, but it is a strong channel signal: the club format is gaining units and dollars while supporting both value and indulgence. Real Dough should treat club-ready pack architecture and a clear value-per-serving case as increasingly important buyer proof.

trends.topic: Foreign-material risk remains active in frozen foodservice supply chains
trends.magnitude: Fontanini recalled approximately 2,320 pounds of frozen pork sausage after two customer complaints; distribution reached four states.
trends.context: The affected product is foodservice breakfast sausage, not pizza, and the recall is limited in scale. The practical implication is still relevant for frozen manufacturers: complaint traceability and rapid freezer-inventory notification remain critical because affected cases can sit in distributor and restaurant freezers.

market_data.change: Q4 net income increased 14.8% year over year to nearly $3 billion; comparable digital sales increased 19.8%
